records.body:
=== Hanabi Trio ===

Hanabi Trio is cooperative: the whole team wins or loses together.

Cards. The deck has 30 cards. For each of the 3 colours Red (R), Green (G) and Blue (B) there are 3 1s, 2 2s, 2 3s, 2 4s and 1 5. A face is written as colour letter plus rank, e.g. R1, G4, B5.

Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. Either way the card leaves your hand.

Discard. The card with that ID is removed from your hand, its face is revealed and '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile. hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8: discarding with 8 tokens leaves 8. action_log records 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face'.

Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

No talk. There is no message phase. Players may communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

Result. Every seat whose total is at least 13 wins. Since all totals equal team_score (pile red + pile green + pile blue, at most 15), the team either wins together with team_score 13 or more, or loses together below 13. Pile progress counts even if the game ended on the third fuse.

records.prompt:
[user]
=== Hanabi Trio ===

Hanabi Trio is cooperative: the whole team wins or loses together.

Cards. The deck has 30 cards. For each of the 3 colours Red (R), Green (G) and Blue (B) there are 3 1s, 2 2s, 2 3s, 2 4s and 1 5. A face is written as colour letter plus rank, e.g. R1, G4, B5.

Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. Either way the card leaves your hand.

Discard. The card with that ID is removed from your hand, its face is revealed and '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile. hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8: discarding with 8 tokens leaves 8. action_log records 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face'.

Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

No talk. There is no message phase. Players may communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

Result. Every seat whose total is at least 13 wins. Since all totals equal team_score (pile red + pile green + pile blue, at most 15), the team either wins together with team_score 13 or more, or loses together below 13. Pile progress counts even if the game ended on the third fuse.

Hanabi Trio is cooperative: the whole team wins or loses together.

Cards. The deck has 30 cards. For each of the 3 colours Red (R), Green (G) and Blue (B) there are 3 1s, 2 2s, 2 3s, 2 4s and 1 5. A face is written as colour letter plus rank, e.g. R1, G4, B5.

Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. Either way the card leaves your hand.

Discard. The card with that ID is removed from your hand, its face is revealed and '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile. hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8: discarding with 8 tokens leaves 8. action_log records 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face'.

Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

No talk. There is no message phase. Players may communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

Result. Every seat whose total is at least 13 wins. Since all totals equal team_score (pile red + pile green + pile blue, at most 15), the team either wins together with team_score 13 or more, or loses together below 13. Pile progress counts even if the game ended on the third fuse.

Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. Either way the card leaves your hand.

Discard. The card with that ID is removed from your hand, its face is revealed and '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile. hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8: discarding with 8 tokens leaves 8. action_log records 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face'.

Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

No talk. There is no message phase. Players may communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

Result. Every seat whose total is at least 13 wins. Since all totals equal team_score (pile red + pile green + pile blue, at most 15), the team either wins together with team_score 13 or more, or loses together below 13. Pile progress counts even if the game ended on the third fuse.

[user]
=== Hanabi Trio ===

Hanabi Trio is cooperative: the whole team wins or loses together.

Cards. The deck has 30 cards. For each of the 3 colours Red (R), Green (G) and Blue (B) there are 3 1s, 2 2s, 2 3s, 2 4s and 1 5. A face is written as colour letter plus rank, e.g. R1, G4, B5.

Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. Either way the card leaves your hand.

Discard. The card with that ID is removed from your hand, its face is revealed and '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile. hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8: discarding with 8 tokens leaves 8. action_log records 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face'.

Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

No talk. There is no message phase. Players may communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

Result. Every seat whose total is at least 13 wins. Since all totals equal team_score (pile red + pile green + pile blue, at most 15), the team either wins together with team_score 13 or more, or loses together below 13. Pile progress counts even if the game ended on the third fuse.

[user]
=== Hanabi Trio ===

Hanabi Trio is cooperative: the whole team wins or loses together.

Cards. The deck has 30 cards. For each of the 3 colours Red (R), Green (G) and Blue (B) there are 3 1s, 2 2s, 2 3s, 2 4s and 1 5. A face is written as colour letter plus rank, e.g. R1, G4, B5.

Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. Either way the card leaves your hand.

Discard. The card with that ID is removed from your hand, its face is revealed and '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile. hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8: discarding with 8 tokens leaves 8. action_log records 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face'.

Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

No talk. There is no message phase. Players may communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

Result. Every seat whose total is at least 13 wins. Since all totals equal team_score (pile red + pile green + pile blue, at most 15), the team either wins together with team_score 13 or more, or loses together below 13. Pile progress counts even if the game ended on the third fuse.

[user]
=== Hanabi Trio ===

Hanabi Trio is cooperative: the whole team wins or loses together.

Cards. The deck has 30 cards. For each of the 3 colours Red (R), Green (G) and Blue (B) there are 3 1s, 2 2s, 2 3s, 2 4s and 1 5. A face is written as colour letter plus rank, e.g. R1, G4, B5.

Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. Either way the card leaves your hand.

Discard. The card with that ID is removed from your hand, its face is revealed and '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile. hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8: discarding with 8 tokens leaves 8. action_log records 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face'.

Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

No talk. There is no message phase. Players may communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

[user]
=== Hanabi Trio ===

Hanabi Trio is cooperative: the whole team wins or loses together.

Cards. The deck has 30 cards. For each of the 3 colours Red (R), Green (G) and Blue (B) there are 3 1s, 2 2s, 2 3s, 2 4s and 1 5. A face is written as colour letter plus rank, e.g. R1, G4, B5.

Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. Either way the card leaves your hand.

Discard. The card with that ID is removed from your hand, its face is revealed and '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile. hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8: discarding with 8 tokens leaves 8. action_log records 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face'.

Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

No talk. There is no message phase. Players may communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

Result. Every seat whose total is at least 13 wins. Since all totals equal team_score (pile red + pile green + pile blue, at most 15), the team either wins together with team_score 13 or more, or loses together below 13. Pile progress counts even if the game ended on the third fuse.

=== Hanabi Trio ===

Hanabi Trio is cooperative: the whole team wins or loses together.

Cards. The deck has 30 cards. For each of the 3 colours Red (R), Green (G) and Blue (B) there are 3 1s, 2 2s, 2 3s, 2 4s and 1 5. A face is written as colour letter plus rank, e.g. R1, G4, B5.

Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. Either way the card leaves your hand.

Discard. The card with that ID is removed from your hand, its face is revealed and '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile. hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8: discarding with 8 tokens leaves 8. action_log records 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face'.

Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

No talk. There is no message phase. Players may communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

Result. Every seat whose total is at least 13 wins. Since all totals equal team_score (pile red + pile green + pile blue, at most 15), the team either wins together with team_score 13 or more, or loses together below 13. Pile progress counts even if the game ended on the third fuse.

=== Hanabi Trio ===

Hanabi Trio is cooperative: the whole team wins or loses together.

Cards. The deck has 30 cards. For each of the 3 colours Red (R), Green (G) and Blue (B) there are 3 1s, 2 2s, 2 3s, 2 4s and 1 5. A face is written as colour letter plus rank, e.g. R1, G4, B5.

Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

[user]
=== Hanabi Trio ===

Hanabi Trio is cooperative: the whole team wins or loses together.

Cards. The deck has 30 cards. For each of the 3 colours Red (R), Green (G) and Blue (B) there are 3 1s, 2 2s, 2 3s, 2 4s and 1 5. A face is written as colour letter plus rank, e.g. R1, G4, B5.

Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. Either way the card leaves your hand.

Discard. The card with that ID is removed from your hand, its face is revealed and '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile. hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8: discarding with 8 tokens leaves 8. action_log records 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face'.

Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

No talk. There is no message phase. Players may communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

Result. Every seat whose total is at least 13 wins. Since all totals equal team_score (pile red + pile green + pile blue, at most 15), the team either wins together with team_score 13 or more, or loses together below 13. Pile progress counts even if the game ended on the third fuse.

[user]
=== Hanabi Trio ===

Hanabi Trio is cooperative: the whole team wins or loses together.

Cards. The deck has 30 cards. For each of the 3 colours Red (R), Green (G) and Blue (B) there are 3 1s, 2 2s, 2 3s, 2 4s and 1 5. A face is written as colour letter plus rank, e.g. R1, G4, B5.

Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. Either way the card leaves your hand.

Discard. The card with that ID is removed from your hand, its face is revealed and '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile. hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8: discarding with 8 tokens leaves 8. action_log records 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face'.

Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

No talk. There is no message phase. Players may communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

Result. Every seat whose total is at least 13 wins. Since all totals equal team_score (pile red + pile green + pile blue, at most 15), the team either wins together with team_score 13 or more, or loses together below 13. Pile progress counts even if the game ended on the third fuse.

records.prompt:
[user]
=== Hanabi Trio ===

Hanabi Trio is cooperative: the whole team wins or loses together.

Cards. The deck has 30 cards. For each of the 3 colours Red (R), Green (G) and Blue (B) there are 3 1s, 2 2s, 2 3s, 2 4s and 1 5. A face is written as colour letter plus rank, e.g. R1, G4, B5.

Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. Either way the card leaves your hand.

Discard. The card with that ID is removed from your hand, its face is revealed and '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile. hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8: discarding with 8 tokens leaves 8. action_log records 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face'.

Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

No talk. There is no message phase. Players may communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

Result. Every seat whose total is at least 13 wins. Since all totals equal team_score (pile red + pile green + pile blue, at most 15), the team either wins together with team_score 13 or more, or loses together below 13. Pile progress counts even if the game ended on the third fuse.

Players: 3. Seats are numbered 1 to 3.
You are seat 1, Ada. Seats are referred to by number.

[user]
=== Hanabi Trio ===

Hanabi Trio is cooperative: the whole team wins or loses together.

Cards. The deck has 30 cards. For each of the 3 colours Red (R), Green (G) and Blue (B) there are 3 1s, 2 2s, 2 3s, 2 4s and 1 5. A face is written as colour letter plus rank, e.g. R1, G4, B5.

Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. Either way the card leaves your hand.

Discard. The card with that ID is removed from your hand, its face is revealed and '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile. hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8: discarding with 8 tokens leaves 8. action_log records 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face'.

Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

No talk. There is no message phase. Players may communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

Result. Every seat whose total is at least 13 wins. Since all totals equal team_score (pile red + pile green + pile blue, at most 15), the team either wins together with team_score 13 or more, or loses together below 13. Pile progress counts even if the game ended on the third fuse.

[user]
=== Hanabi Trio ===

Hanabi Trio is cooperative: the whole team wins or loses together.

Cards. The deck has 30 cards. For each of the 3 colours Red (R), Green (G) and Blue (B) there are 3 1s, 2 2s, 2 3s, 2 4s and 1 5. A face is written as colour letter plus rank, e.g. R1, G4, B5.

Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. Either way the card leaves your hand.

Discard. The card with that ID is removed from your hand, its face is revealed and '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile. hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8: discarding with 8 tokens leaves 8. action_log records 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face'.

Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

No talk. There is no message phase. Players may communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

Result. Every seat whose total is at least 13 wins. Since all totals equal team_score (pile red + pile green + pile blue, at most 15), the team either wins together with team_score 13 or more, or loses together below 13. Pile progress counts even if the game ended on the third fuse.

[user]
=== Hanabi Trio ===

Hanabi Trio is cooperative: the whole team wins or loses together.

Cards. The deck has 30 cards. For each of the 3 colours Red (R), Green (G) and Blue (B) there are 3 1s, 2 2s, 2 3s, 2 4s and 1 5. A face is written as colour letter plus rank, e.g. R1, G4, B5.

Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. Either way the card leaves your hand.

Discard. The card with that ID is removed from your hand, its face is revealed and '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile. hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8: discarding with 8 tokens leaves 8. action_log records 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face'.

Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

No talk. There is no message phase. Players may communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

Result. Every seat whose total is at least 13 wins. Since all totals equal team_score (pile red + pile green + pile blue, at most 15), the team either wins together with team_score 13 or more, or loses together below 13. Pile progress counts even if the game ended on the third fuse.

[user]
=== Hanabi Trio ===

Hanabi Trio is cooperative: the whole team wins or loses together.

Cards. The deck has 30 cards. For each of the 3 colours Red (R), Green (G) and Blue (B) there are 3 1s, 2 2s, 2 3s, 2 4s and 1 5. A face is written as colour letter plus rank, e.g. R1, G4, B5.

Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. Either way the card leaves your hand.

Discard. The card with that ID is removed from your hand, its face is revealed and '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile. hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8: discarding with 8 tokens leaves 8. action_log records 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face'.

Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

No talk. There is no message phase. Players may communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

Result. Every seat whose total is at least 13 wins. Since all totals equal team_score (pile red + pile green + pile blue, at most 15), the team either wins together with team_score 13 or more, or loses together below 13. Pile progress counts even if the game ended on the third fuse.

records.prompt:
[user]
=== Hanabi Trio ===

Hanabi Trio is cooperative: the whole team wins or loses together.

Cards. The deck has 30 cards. For each of the 3 colours Red (R), Green (G) and Blue (B) there are 3 1s, 2 2s, 2 3s, 2 4s and 1 5. A face is written as colour letter plus rank, e.g. R1, G4, B5.

Shuffle and IDs. At setup the faces are shuffled once into a hidden deck. The cards carry IDs #1, #2, ... #30 in deck order, so each ID always belongs to the same card. An ID never reveals a face. The front of the deck is the top. Whenever a card moves, its ID and its face move together.

Hand sizes. With 2 players each hand has 5 cards and the deck starts with 20. With 3 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 18. With 4 players each hand has 4 cards and the deck starts with 14. Seat 1 takes the top hand-size cards, then seat 2 the next, and so on: with 3 players seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30. deck_count is always the number of cards left in the deck.

Visibility. Every player sees every seat's hand_ids. Every player sees every other seat's hand_faces, but never their own. The piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score and turns_played are public.

Starting state. The red, green and blue piles start at 0. Hint tokens start at 8 (maximum 8). Fuses start at 3. Team score starts at 0. The discard pile and action log start empty. Turns played starts at 0. final_turns_left starts at -1. Seat 1 acts first.

Turn order. One round is one turn by the active seat. Seats act in order 1, 2, ... up to the last seat, then seat 1 again. Only the active seat is asked to choose.

Legal options. At the start of your turn you are offered: PLAY #id for each ID in your hand; DISCARD #id for each ID in your hand; and, only if hint_tokens is at least 1, HINT s v for each other seat s and each value v in R, G, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand. With 0 hint tokens no HINT is offered. Choose exactly one option.

Hint. hint_tokens falls by 1. A line is added to action_log naming the giver, the receiver, the value and every ID in the receiver's hand that matches it, e.g. 'turn 4: seat 1 hints seat 2 R = #5, #7'. Hints are public and are not otherwise stored. No card moves and nobody draws.

Play. The card with that ID is removed from your hand. The play succeeds if the card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile: that pile becomes the card's rank and team_score rises by 1; if the rank is 5 and hint_tokens is below 8, hint_tokens rises by 1 (at 8 it stays 8); action_log records 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success'. If the play does not succeed, fuses falls by exactly 1, the piles and team_score are unchanged, '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile, and action_log records the failure with the face. Either way the card leaves your hand.

Discard. The card with that ID is removed from your hand, its face is revealed and '#id=face' is added to the end of discard_pile. hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8: discarding with 8 tokens leaves 8. action_log records 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face'.

Drawing. After a PLAY or DISCARD, if the deck is not empty, you draw its top card (ID and face together) to the end of your hand; if the deck is empty you draw nothing. If this draw empties the deck and final_turns_left is -1, final_turns_left is set to the number of players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.

End of turn. Every seat's total is set to team_score. turns_played rises by 1. If final_turns_left is above 0, it falls by 1. The turn passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

Game end. The game ends at the end of a turn if fuses is 0, or team_score is 15, or final_turns_left is 0 (every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied), or turns_played is 40. Otherwise play continues.

No talk. There is no message phase. Players may communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

Result. Every seat whose total is at least 13 wins. Since all totals equal team_score (pile red + pile green + pile blue, at most 15), the team either wins together with team_score 13 or more, or loses together below 13. Pile progress counts even if the game ended on the third fuse.
